title: [AUG-192] Send to Praxis: Recent picked folders (max 5) that survive restarts
why_we_need_this: Rodion's Bug Fix 2 (@docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md): a project picked by folder in Send to Praxis is forgotten, so the path is re-entered every time. Root cause (AUG-171): PraxisModal keeps the last path in localStorage (@client/src/components/PraxisModal.tsx:80,102-126,186-199), but the packaged app starts the server on port 0 (@electron/src/main.ts:195,610), so the origin and its localStorage change on every launch. Decision in AUG-171: option C from @docs/mockups/AUG-171/send-to-praxis.html, cap changed to 5 by Vlad. Picked folders are reused in one click and the registered Projects list stays curated, so wrong picks don't turn into "15 projects".
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] New server preference `praxisRecentPaths: string[]` (allowed key, client `UserPreferences` type, default `[]`), sanitized on every PATCH: strings only, trimmed, empty dropped, deduped by resolved path case-insensitively (same rule as `sanitizePraxisProjects`), paths already in `praxisProjects` dropped, at most 5 entries, newest first.
- [ ] After a task is created successfully (transcript card and action-items export), if the sent path is not a registered project, it is moved to the front of `praxisRecentPaths`; the 6th oldest drops off. Failed validation or a failed send never adds a path.
- [ ] The `localStorage['august-praxis-project-path']` read/write in PraxisModal is replaced: on open, the newest recent path (if any, and no registered project matched it) is preselected; otherwise the current default / first project logic is kept. Verified by restarting the packaged or dev app: the last-sent unregistered folder is still offered.
- [ ] Chips mode (1–5 registered projects): after the registered chips, a "Recent" label and one dashed-border chip per recent path (name = folder basename, sub = shortened path, title = full path), each with × (remove from `praxisRecentPaths`) and Save (append to `praxisProjects` named after the folder, remove from recents); then "Other…". Selecting a recent chip fills the Project path field. Matches option C of the mockup.
- [ ] Dropdown mode (more than 5 registered projects, or 0 registered): recent paths appear as a "Recent" group in the list / as chips with the same × and Save actions; the user can reach and remove every recent entry in both modes.
- [ ] A Cyrillic path picked via "Open" (e.g. `D:\Проекты\x` on Windows, `/Users/x/Проекты/y` on macOS) is stored and shown exactly as picked (never the 8.3 short form) and sends successfully after an app restart; if the Windows folder picker returns mojibake for non-ASCII paths, that is fixed or logged as a separate task with the repro.
- [ ] `npm run build` (client + server) and the existing preferencesStore / praxisIntegration tests pass.
important_constraints: Mockup: @docs/mockups/AUG-171/send-to-praxis.html (option C; cap is 5, not 3 as drawn). Research: AUG-171-tm3lsm. Don't change Settings → Projects, except that Save adds an ordinary project there. Brandbook: 0 border-radius; dashed border marks a recent chip; × must not be the only remove path without a visible target (keep hit area ≥ 16px). Cross-platform: path.resolve dedupe on the server, no hardcoded separators, Windows + macOS both. Don't store recents in localStorage (origin port changes each launch). Roadmap: M1 Quick fixes.
